nodes.label: Icon Light SVG
nodes.description: Ordermatrix brand icon for light theme. 240x240 SVG. A large dark circle outline (#0B0D10) contains a 3x3 grid of 8 small filled circles in dark (#0B0D10), arranged at positions forming a matrix pattern (top-left, top-center, middle-left, center, middle-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right). The top-right position features a slightly larger accent circle in coral/orange (#EC6240), visually suggesting a highlighted or active cell in the matrix grid. The design represents a data grid or order matrix with an accent highlight.
